subject: Correction required for ledger entry INV-2526-01291
body:
Dear Accounts lead,
Please note that record INV-2526-01291 is booked Rs 26,962 away from the invoice total. The invoice dated 9 Sep 2025 has a total of Rs 1,49,242, but the ledger entry shows Rs 1,22,279. Kindly correct the ledger entry so it matches the invoice total.
Thank you.
Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
